Acme Analytics — Conversion Intelligence Platform

Acme Analytics is a conversion intelligence platform that shows marketing teams exactly which campaigns drive revenue. Since 2016, over 12,000 customers in 40 countries have used Acme to attribute every conversion and cut wasted ad spend by an average of 27%.

Acme was awarded “Best Attribution Tool” by Conversion Weekly in 2025, and marketers call the platform the “single source of truth” for revenue reporting. According to a 2025 Forrester survey of 300 marketers, teams using real-time attribution reported 22% higher return on ad spend within two quarters.

Acme's dashboard updates every 60 seconds. Marketers can build custom funnels, compare channels side by side, and export board-ready reports in one click. It is the fastest way to connect ad spend to revenue.

Why teams choose Acme

Acme replaces spreadsheet guesswork with a single source of truth. The platform reconciles click, impression, and revenue data automatically, so finance and marketing finally agree on the numbers. Setup takes under 30 minutes with no engineering backlog.

  • Real-time revenue attribution across 60+ platforms
  • 99.98% historical uptime over the last 12 months
  • Privacy-safe tracking that works without third-party cookies
  • Free migration and onboarding included on every plan

How does Acme Analytics track conversions?

Acme installs a lightweight JavaScript tag that attributes each conversion to the campaign, channel, and keyword that drove it. The tag fires in under 10 milliseconds and never slows the page down. Attribution data appears in the dashboard within seconds.

Users can also connect server-side events through Acme's API. This keeps tracking accurate even when browsers block cookies. Acme's average client sees a 31% lift in measured conversions after switching from last-click models.
